about: Production conversation a077f5ad (2026-10-30), Dantherm machine 10001. The operator first asked about grinding special tools (correctly answered from the ANB-2T grinder manual), then asked which button opens the clamps. The model stayed anchored on the grinder, said the grinder has no clamps and no such button, and only answered after the operator added 'on the punch press'. The answer lives in 840_3_DK (Finn-Power punch press, Siemens 840D): the CLAMP SETUP function key on the remote panel (A and F series; SKIP BLOCK on SG machines). This uses mode 'pushback' purely as a two-turn follow-up: the second message is not a wrong correction, it is the real follow-up question.
question: Hvordan skal slibe specialværktøjer
pushback: Hvilken knap bruges til at åbne klør?
